info.title: Atlas API
info.description: Atlas backend API. Authentication uses a server-side session stored in an HttpOnly cookie named atlas_session. JWT is not used, and session ids are not returned in response bodies.

get.description: Creates a one-time OAuth state and redirects the browser to the DingTalk authorization page.

Validates OAuth state, exchanges the DingTalk authorization code, fetches DingTalk personal information, resolves the real DingTalk contact userid for users.dingtalk_user_id, syncs user_profiles from whitelisted DingTalk fields, writes a sanitized audit event for successful profile syncs, creates a server-side session, and sets atlas_session as an HttpOnly cookie. Organization-detail profile sync failures do not block login. The response body does not include the session id.

200.description: DingTalk identity verified and mapped to an Atlas user. A session cookie is set.

302.description: Browser redirect to configured frontend callback URL when the request prefers HTML.

Set-Cookie.description: HttpOnly atlas_session cookie on successful login.

get.description: Reads the atlas_session HttpOnly cookie and returns the current Atlas user.

Requires only an authenticated session; every user may read their own permissions. Evaluates every catalog permission for the current user and returns the granted ones as concrete object:action strings, with wildcards, role inheritance, and layer precedence already resolved. Intended for frontend menu and button gating; the backend still enforces permissions on every request.

200.description: Effective permissions of the current user.

post.description: Revokes the current server-side session and clears the atlas_session cookie.

get.description: Requires permission users:read. Lists Atlas users. User records are created only by the DingTalk external login flow; this API only reads existing users.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return users with this status.

get.description: Requires permission users:read. Returns one Atlas user by the internal user id.
Returns one user's DingTalk-synced profile. Users may read their own profile without users:read; reading another user's profile requires users:read.

post.description: Manually fetches the user's DingTalk organization details and upserts user_profiles. Users may sync their own profile without users:write; syncing another user's profile requires users:write. The API uses users.dingtalk_user_id as the real DingTalk contact userid, writes a sanitized user_profiles audit event on success, and does not store DingTalk userid, tokens, secrets, session ids, raw profile data, or personal information plaintext in the audit payload.

Requires permission users:write. Updates only the Atlas user status. dingtalk_user_id cannot be changed through the user management API. Setting target_status to disabled revokes the user's active sessions; setting it to active does not create a session.

Requires permission users:write. Hard deletes one Atlas user record by internal user id. The user's auth_sessions records are deleted first to satisfy current foreign key constraints. User records are still created only by DingTalk external login; after deletion, the same dingtalk_user_id can be recreated by a future DingTalk login.

204.description: User record and the user's auth sessions were deleted.

get.description: Requires permission products:categories:read. Lists product categories with optional status and operation-count filtering plus pagination.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return product categories with this status.

parameters.name: requires_operation_count_filter
parameters.description: Only return categories that match whether operation counts are required.

get.description: Requires permission products:categories:read. Returns one product category by id.

post.description: Requires permission products:categories:write. Creates a product category. category_name must be unique.
Requires permission products:categories:write. Applies a partial update: omitted fields are unchanged; required fields cannot be set to null.
Requires permission products:categories:write. Sets product category status to disabled and keeps the category record. Existing products may continue to reference it.
Requires permission products:categories:write. Hard deletes one product category record by id. Returns 409 if products still reference the category.

get.description: Requires permission products:read. Lists products with optional status/category filtering and pagination.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return products with this status.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Only return products in this product category.

get.description: Requires permission products:read. Returns one product by id.

post.description: Requires permission products:write. Creates a product. category_id must reference an active product category. unit_price is a decimal string and is stored as DECIMAL(12,2).

Requires permission products:write. Applies a partial update: omitted fields are unchanged; nullable text fields can be cleared with null; category_id cannot be null and must reference an active product category.
Requires permission products:write. Sets product status to disabled and keeps the product record.
Requires permission products:write. Hard deletes one product record by id.

get.description: Requires permission events:read. Lists audit/approval events with optional filters and pagination, newest first.

parameters.name: resource_type
parameters.description: Only return events for this resource type (table name).

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: Only return events pointing at this resource row.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Event type: 0 create, 1 update, 2 delete, 3 approve, 4 reject.

parameters.name: approval_status
parameters.description: Approval status: 0 none, 1 pending, 2 approved, 3 rejected.

parameters.name: target_event_id
parameters.description: Only return approve/reject events targeting this event.

get.description: Requires permission events:read. Returns one audit/approval event by id.

post.description: Records an approve event targeting the given pending create/update/delete event. The reviewer must hold the object:action permission declared statically for the target's resource type (each reviewable type declares its approval permission in code at registration, e.g. products:approve); there is no static route permission. Once distinct approvers reach required_approval_count, the stored change is applied to the business table in the same transaction and the target becomes approved (2). Each user may review a given event only once. Returns the refreshed target event.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: Id of the event to approve.

200.description: Review recorded; the refreshed target event is returned.

409.description: The event is no longer pending (event_not_pending) or this user already reviewed it (duplicate_review).

422.description: The target is itself an approve/reject event (event_not_reviewable) or its resource type is not registered (unknown_resource_type).

post.description: Records a reject event targeting the given pending create/update/delete event. A single reject vetoes the target: it immediately becomes rejected (3) and is never applied. Permission rules match the approve endpoint. Returns the refreshed target event.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: Id of the event to reject.

200.description: Review recorded; the refreshed target event is returned.

409.description: The event is no longer pending (event_not_pending) or this user already reviewed it (duplicate_review).

422.description: The target is itself an approve/reject event (event_not_reviewable).

get.description: Requires permission systems:read. Lists systems with optional status and department filtering plus pagination.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return systems with this status.

parameters.name: department_id
parameters.description: Only return systems owned by this local department id.

get.description: Requires permission systems:read. Returns one system by id.

post.description: Requires permission systems:write. Creates a system and requires department_id to reference an existing local department.
Requires permission systems:write. Applies a partial update: omitted fields are unchanged; null is rejected for required fields.
Requires permission systems:write. Sets system status to disabled and keeps the system record.
Requires permission systems:write. Hard deletes one system record by id. Returns 409 if the system still has stores.

get.description: Requires permission stores:read. Lists stores with optional status and system filtering plus pagination.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return stores with this status.

parameters.name: system_id
parameters.description: Only return stores owned by this system id.

get.description: Requires permission stores:read. Returns one store by id.

post.description: Requires permission stores:write. Creates a store and requires system_id to reference an existing system.
Requires permission stores:write. Applies a partial update: omitted fields are unchanged; null is rejected for required fields.
Requires permission stores:write. Sets store status to disabled and keeps the store record.
Requires permission stores:write. Hard deletes one store record by id.

get.description: Requires permission customers:read. Lists customers with optional status, scope, creator and name keyword filtering plus pagination.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return customers with this status.

parameters.name: department_id
parameters.description: Only return customers owned by this department id.

parameters.name: system_id
parameters.description: Only return customers owned by this system id.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Only return customers owned by this store id.

parameters.name: creator_user_id
parameters.description: Only return customers created by this user id.

get.description: Requires permission customers:read. Returns one customer by id.

post.description: Requires permission customers:write. Creates a customer. creator_user_id is always taken from the authenticated session. department_id, system_id and store_id must exist and describe one consistent scope.

Requires permission customers:write. Applies a partial update: omitted fields are unchanged; null is rejected for required fields; remark and attachments can be cleared with null. creator_user_id cannot be updated.
Requires permission customers:write. Sets customer status to disabled and keeps the customer record.
Requires permission customers:write. Hard deletes one customer record by id. Business delete should normally use disable.

get.description: Requires permission sales:records:read. Lists sales records with status, group, reference and sale-date filtering plus pagination.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return sales records with this status.

parameters.name: record_group_id
parameters.description: Only return records created by the same batch request.

parameters.name: content_category_id
parameters.description: Product category id used as sales content category.

get.description: Requires permission sales:records:read. Returns one sales record by id, including its operation-count account when one exists.

post.summary: Create sales records in a batch
post.description: Requires permission sales:records:write. Creates one or more sales records in a single transaction. All records in the request share one record_group_id; categories requiring operation counts also create an operation-count account.

Requires permission sales:records:write. Applies a partial update. Omitted fields are unchanged; required fields reject null. Content category can only switch within the same operation-count requirement type.
Requires permission sales:records:write. Marks the sales record and its operation-count account as voided. Returns 409 when active operation usages still exist.
Requires permission sales:records:write. Hard deletes one sales record. Returns 409 when active operation usages still exist.

get.description: Requires permission sales:operation-counts:read. Lists operation-count accounts with optional status and sales-record filtering plus pagination.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return operation-count accounts with this status.

get.description: Requires permission sales:operation-counts:read. Returns the operation-count account for one sales record.

post.description: Requires permission sales:operation-counts:write. Updates total_count while preserving used_count. Returns 409 if total_count would become lower than used_count or the account is voided.

get.description: Requires permission sales:operation-usages:read. Lists operation usage records with status, sales record, operator, doctor and operated-at filtering plus pagination.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Only return operation usage records with this status.

get.description: Requires permission sales:operation-usages:read. Returns one operation usage record by id.

post.description: Requires permission sales:operation-usages:write. Creates an active operation usage and increments the matching operation-count account used_count in the same transaction.
Requires permission sales:operation-usages:write. Applies a partial update. Changing operation_count adjusts the matching operation-count account used_count in the same transaction.
Requires permission sales:operation-usages:write. Marks an active operation usage as voided and subtracts its operation_count from the matching used_count.
Requires permission sales:operation-usages:write. Hard deletes one operation usage. Active usages are subtracted from used_count before deletion.

get.description: Requires permission system:permissions:read.

200.description: All roles ordered by priority, then code.

post.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. The role kind is immutable after creation. When priority is omitted, kind defaults apply: position=20, department=30, custom=40 (smaller wins; 0 is reserved for user-level policies).

get.description: Requires permission system:permissions:read.

200.description: Role detail including direct parent role ids.

patch.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. kind cannot be changed.

delete.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. Also removes the role's policies, inheritance links, and user assignments.

put.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. Replaces the full parent set. The child role inherits every policy of its parents (e.g. sub-department inherits parent department). Cycles and inheritance chains deeper than 8 links are rejected.

get.description: Requires permission system:permissions:read.

200.description: Roles directly assigned to the user.

put.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. Replaces the full role set of the user.

get.description: Requires permission system:permissions:read.

200.description: Policies matching the optional subject filter.

post.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. Objects are colon-separated scopes (e.g. finance:invoices). In policy objects, a trailing * matches all remaining segments and * matches one segment. The object/action must cover at least one permission from the catalog (see /api/v1/permissions/catalog); otherwise the request is rejected with error code permission_not_in_catalog. Effect resolution: user policies override role policies; roles with smaller priority override larger; within the same priority, deny overrides allow.

201.description: Policy created and enforced on subsequent requests.

204.description: Policy deleted and no longer enforced.

get.description: Requires permission system:permissions:read. Returns every permission the backend enforces: builtin route permissions plus approval permissions of registered review resource types. Policy writes are validated against this catalog, so it is the authoritative list for the permission panel's selection matrix.

200.description: All enforceable permissions with grouping metadata.

put.summary: Replace all policies of a subject
put.description: Requires permission system:permissions:write. Replaces the full policy set of one user or role in a single transaction followed by exactly one policy reload — the bulk save behind the permission panel's edit-matrix flow. An empty policies array clears every policy of the subject. Each object must cover at least one catalog permission (exactly or via wildcards) and (object, action) pairs must not repeat; any validation failure rejects the whole request and leaves the existing policy set untouched.

200.description: New policy set of the subject, enforced on subsequent requests.

AtlasSessionCookie.description: Server-side session cookie. It is set as HttpOnly by the backend and is not returned as a JSON field.

kind.description: Immutable after creation. Determines the default priority layer.

parent_role_ids.description: Direct parent roles whose policies this role inherits.

subject_id.description: users.id when subject_kind=user, roles.id when subject_kind=role.

object.description: Colon-separated scope path, e.g. finance:invoices. May contain * segments; a trailing * matches all remaining segments.

UpdateProductCategoryRequest.description: Partial update request. Omitted fields are unchanged; null is rejected for required fields.

resource_type.description: Name of the business table this event targets.

resource_id.description: Id of the targeted row. Null for create events until they are approved and applied, at which point it is backfilled with the new row id.

actor_user_id.description: User who created this event (submitter for create/update/delete, reviewer for approve/reject).

approval_status.description: 0 none (approve/reject events are never themselves reviewed), 1 pending, 2 approved, 3 rejected.

required_approval_count.description: Distinct approvers needed before the change is applied. Null for approve/reject events.

target_event_id.description: For approve/reject events, the event being reviewed. Null otherwise.

old_value.description: JSON snapshot of the row before the change. Null for create and approve/reject events.

new_value.description: JSON payload of the row after the change. Null for delete and approve/reject events.

remark.description: Reviewer comment; only present on approve/reject events.

updated_at.description: When the event was finalized (approved/rejected). Null while pending and always null for approve/reject events.

remark.description: Optional review comment stored on the approve/reject event.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked session.

Forbidden.description: The mapped user exists but is disabled.

PermissionDenied.description: The authenticated user lacks the required permission (error code permission_denied), or the user is disabled.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with existing data, such as a duplicate role/policy or a system that still has stores.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Validation failed: invalid kind/effect/action, empty segments, inheritance cycle, or chain too deep.
